## Architecture Overview

The **Proteomic GWAS Catalogue** combines a 4-source literature discovery & dual-axis triage engine (`src/run_literature_search.R`), a 4-tier cascading paper/supplement/portal metadata extractor (`src/extract_candidate_study.R`), a strictly blinded positive-control benchmark evaluator (`src/evaluate_positive_controls.R`), and canonical Git-versioned TSV tables (`catalogue/*.tsv`) rendered via Quarto + Observable JS (`site/`).

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  subgraph Search["1. Multi-Source Discovery & Dual-Axis Triage"]
    S1["PubMed E-utilities POST\n+ Europe PMC (MED/PMC/PPR)\n+ GWAS Catalog v2 + 6-Seed Snowball"] --> S2["Graph Deduplication &\n4-Tier Preprint Upgrade Check"]
    S2 --> S3["Stage 1 Hard Gates +\nStage 2 P_score vs S_score Rubric"]
  end

  subgraph Extract["2. Four-Tier Paper & Supplement Extraction"]
    S3 -->|"Actionable Primary Candidates\n(17-col candidate_queue.tsv)"| E1["Tier 1: Europe PMC, PubMed XML,\nCrossref, Unpaywall, GWAS Catalog v2"]
    E1 --> E2["Tier 2: Legal OA Full-Text JATS XML /\nPMC BioC Section Parser"]
    E2 --> E3["Tier 3: BioStudies / supplmat BioC /\nLow-RSS .xlsx Streamer + Portal Preflight\n+ Sentinel rsID Genome-Build Resolver"]
    E3 --> E4{"Tier 4: All Mandatory Fields\nVerified & Conflict-Free?"}
    E4 -- "Yes" --> R1["staging/*_draft_*.tsv\n(Ready for Curator Sign-Off)"]
    E4 -- "Missing / Closed Methods /\nPortal Gate" --> R2["NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW\nstaging/*_review.md Checklist"]
  end

  R1 & R2 -->|"Curator PR Merge"| V["src/validate_catalogue.R &\nsrc/build_site_data.R"]
  V -->|"Static Site"| W["Quarto + Observable JS App"]
  S3 -.->|"Air-gapped post-hoc check"| PC["src/evaluate_positive_controls.R\n(--mode blinded-summary)"]
```

## Relational Table Design (`catalogue/`)

| File | Primary Key | Unit of Observation | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `catalogue/studies.tsv` | `study_id` | 1 row per paper or preprint (`<author>_<year>_PMID<pmid>`) | Citation metadata, `Published` vs `Preprint` vs `Superseded Preprint`, `superseded_by` lineage, repository, URL, and HTTP-verified `access_level`. |
| `catalogue/strata.tsv` | `stratum_id` | 1 row per downloadable GWAS dataset within a study | Ancestry (`EUR`, `AFR`, `EAS`, `CSA`, `AMR`, `MID`, `Multi-ancestry`), sex, post-QC genetic `n_samples` (no sample-size cutoff), 12-category `sample_matrix`, platform & version, `n_assays`, `genome_build`, `coverage`, transformation, `effect_scale`, `has_eaf`, `indel_encoding`, and `gwasprocessing_yaml`. |
| `catalogue/cohort_membership.tsv` | `(study_id, cohort)` | 1 row per participating biobank/cohort | Powers exact participant-overlap warnings before meta-analysis or two-sample MR. |
| `catalogue/proteins_index.tsv` | `(stratum_id, assay_id)` | 1 row per assayed protein target per stratum | Maps `UniProt` + `gene_symbol` + platform `assay_id` (`SeqId`, `OlinkID`, MS peptide, `NULISA`) to standardized `UNIPROT_ASSAYID` names. |
| `catalogue/candidate_queue.tsv` | `candidate_id` | 17-column discovery-to-extraction handoff queue | Passes `pmid`, `doi`, `pmcid`, `epmc_id`, `matched_sources`, `p_score`, `s_score`, and `preprint_lineage_note` into `src/extract_candidate_study.R`. |

## Key CLI Workflows

```bash
# 1. Launch local interactive preview anytime (Ctrl+C to stop)
cd ~/research/proteomic-gwas-catalogue && ~/.local/bin/quarto preview site

# 2. Targeted 2-paper verification of search + triage (no broad search executed)
Rscript src/run_literature_search.R \
  --verify-pmids 37794186,34857953 \
  --out-dir output/verify_search

# 3. 4-tier cascading extraction on a candidate study (paper -> supplements -> portal -> provenance)
Rscript src/extract_candidate_study.R \
  --pmid 37794186 \
  --out-dir output/extract_test

# 4. Blinded positive-control recall & triage-survival evaluation (strictly air-gapped)
#    See catalogue/schema/positive_controls_template.tsv for input format
Rscript src/evaluate_positive_controls.R \
  --controls data/positive_controls.tsv \
  --dump data/search_dump_<run_id>.tsv \
  --mode blinded-summary
```
